title: Frictionless Accelerator — onramp recipes & starter lanes (scratchpad)
content:
PURPOSE:
Quick personal brainstorm for a small feature bundle to dramatically shorten time-to-first-success for new devs integrating Redwood. Working name: Frictionless Accelerator. This is a scratchpad — lots of half-formed ideas below, prioritized toward an MVP we can ship in ~6 weeks.

PROBLEM WE'RE SOLVING:
- New teams and engineers spend too long configuring models, routes, and cost guards before they can iterate on product UX.
- Docs + SDK examples are good but too generic; missing product-shaped starter experiences that map to common workloads (chat, summarization, semantic search).

GOAL / HIGH-LEVEL SUCCESS METRICS:
- Reduce median time from signup -> first successful API call from X hours to <30 minutes (activation time).
- Increase percentage of new trial teams that create a route + make >=100 requests within 7 days by 20%.
- Surface unit-cost estimates before first call (reduce surprise billing).

CORE CONCEPTS (frankly nicknames):
- Starter Lanes: curated, clickable presets in Console (Chat lane, Q/A lane, Embedding lane) that create a route, sample prompt templates, SDK snippet and a small prompt set for eval.
- Onramp Recipes: 1-click config bundles (model + quantization + batch policy + cache TTL) optimized per lane and per customer tier.
- Playground-as-Template: an ephemeral sandbox preloaded with a sample dataset and a test harness (replay + mock user events). Shareable link to reproduce.
- Token-Thrift Presets: cost-first configs (shorter max tokens, lower temperature, smaller model variant) for trial accounts to prevent runaway cost.
- Preview Mode: dry-run mode that returns token cost estimates and top-level quality metrics (BLEU / ROUGE / embedding-similarity) on sample prompts without actually billing.

USER STORIES (Rough)
- As a product engineer, I want a console button “Start chat lane” that provisions a route + SDK snippet so I can prototype in my app in minutes.
  - Acceptance: clicking creates route, console shows sample curl + JS snippets, playground opens with three prefilled prompts.

- As a growth/product manager, I want a shareable sandbox link to show a stakeholder the feature so they can click and try without creating an account.
  - Acceptance: share link spins up ephemeral sandbox that expires after 48h; actions recorded to demo logs.

- As an SRE/finance reviewer, I want token-thrift presets that cap per-request tokens and estimate monthly burn so trials don’t blow budgets.
  - Acceptance: preset enforces max_tokens=256, shows estimate in UI, enforces route-level quota at 10k tokens/day for trial.

MVP SCOPE (target 6 weeks)
- Implement 3 Starter Lanes: Chat, Summarize, Embeddings.
- Console: new “Create from starter” flow with 1-click route + sample SDK code (curl + node).
- Playground-as-Template: ephemeral sandbox with prefilled prompts and a small dataset (500 lines).
- Token-Thrift presets for trial orgs only.
- Instrumentation: funnel events (create-starter -> open-playground -> first-api-call).

MVP+ (nice to have)
- Dry-run Preview Mode that returns cost and rough quality scores on sample prompts.
- GitHub quickstart: repo template that wires the starter route into a minimal web UI.
- SDK helper: new helper method createStarterRoute(lane, options) to programmatically provision.

METRICS & EXPERIMENTS
- Activation latency (signup -> first succesful call). Target <30m for top quartile.
- Starter conversion: % of users who use a starter lane that make >=100 requests in 7d.
- Cost surprises: % of trial orgs that see >50% unexpected spend relative to forecast.
- A/B: show Starter Lanes on signup vs show in Console only. Measure activation and retention.

IMPLEMENTATION NOTES / TECH RISKS
- Route provisioning: reuse existing route-creation API (small wrapper). Need a lightweight role check for ephemeral sandboxes.
- Billing estimates: approximate token counts are easy; predicting multi-day usage is hard. Start simple: per-request estimate + simple daily cap projection.
- Data for playground: host a tiny canned dataset in S3; ensure we redact any PII.
- Security: ephemeral sandboxes must be isolated from customer org data; sandbox accounts should not have access to private models.

DEPENDENCIES
- Console: console-team (PR: rw-console/pull/1290).
- Billing: small API to apply route-level quota for trials (Jira DEVX-1128).
- SDK: new helper method (owner: developer-experience sdk workstream).
- Docs: short quickstart page and video (owner: docs-team).

ROLLOUT PLAN (phased)
- Week 1–2: Console UI + route template + sample snippets. Internal dogfood (eng teams).
- Week 3: Ephemeral playground + share link. Invite beta customers.
- Week 4–6: Add token-thrift presets + instrumentation + A/B experiment.

EXPERIMENT MATRIX (ideas)
- Variant A: Starter Lanes surfaced on first sign-in (modal).
- Variant B: Starter Lanes in Console under “Get started” (less interruptive).
- Variant C: Starter + automated email with one-click starter link.

OPEN QUESTIONS / THINGS TO DECIDE
- Do we allow private models in starter lanes for enterprise trials? (lean: no for MVP).
- How many starter lanes to ship? (3 feels right).
- How to price shareable sandboxes if they become heavy (cost attribution)?
- UX: confirm/cancel flow for provisioning to avoid accidental spend.

QUICK TODOs (near-term)
- [ ] Wire up a tiny route-template JSON and test createRoute API with sample inputs (owner: Sam).
- [ ] Console mockups for Starter Lanes (owner: Tess).
- [ ] Billing guard: implement route-level soft-quota for trial orgs (owner: Ethan).
- [ ] Draft docs + 90s video for homepage hero (owner: Amelia).

NOTES / RANDOM IDEAS
- Could offer ‘starter lanes marketplace’ later where Solution Engineers publish premade templates for specific verticals (search + kb ingestion, convo summarizer for legal teams).
- Add a telemetry badge: small cost + latency summary shown on route tile so teams can see economics at a glance.
- A tiny CLI: rw accelerate start chat --org demo -> provisions route + prints SDK snippet.

REFERENCES / LINKS
- DEVX-1128 (billing guard ticket)
- rw-console/pull/1290 (console stub for starter flow)
- Confluence draft: Frictionless Accelerator Overview (linked above)

END NOTES: This feels like a high-leverage, low-complexity bundle if we limit scope. Main thesis: ship small, visible wins that lower the activation barrier and reduce cost friction for trials. Will iterate after first 100 orgs go through flow.

Scratchpad sign-off: will convert to a short PRD after feedback from Sam/Tess/Ethan.
